name: regtrace
description: Policy-aware planning and post-implementation code review for Claude.
long_description: RegTrace lets Claude review implementation plans and actual repository code against company policies before and after development.

tools.name: regtrace_review_plan
tools.description: Review Claude's implementation plan against company policies and the actual repository before coding.

tools.name: regtrace_review_fix
tools.description: Review actual repository code against company policies and apply Claude-generated corrections when required.
